name: Zoth ZeUSD router opened unslippaged USDC deposits
summary: ZeUSD_Router mints ZeUSD equal to deposited USDC while WMSubVault swaps that USDC to wM, and back on redemption, on Uniswap V3 with amountOutMinimum 0. An upgrade dropped the router's whitelist; the attacker then flash-borrowed USDC, skewed the wM/USDC pool, minted ZeUSD cheaply and burned it after resetting the pool, so the vault sold its depositors' wM to pay it.
notes: The router upgrade dropped whitelistedOnly from mintWithStable; a fork replay of the anchor with the previous implementation 0x1e53b208 reverts. The sub-vault's zero-bound swaps date from its last pre-exploit upgrade, so the exploitable combination dates from the router upgrade.

Net wM depletion of the sub-vault, wM (wrapped M, a T-bill-backed USD stablecoin) at par since DefiLlama has no quote; the vault's 3,294.92 USDC residual gain is not netted. The 39,593,862 ZeUSD minted against 6.40 wM was burned by Zoth's admin without redemption, so it adds no loss.
Out of scope: Zoth's March 21, 2025 loss came from a compromised admin key upgrading a proxy (privileged action), a separate event outside the cohort.
